candidate_relations.reason: Ependymoma is a solid glial tumor and does not match the nonenhancing extra-axial neurenteric cyst diagnosis.
Meningioma typically enhances and is not equivalent to a neurenteric cyst.
An arachnoid cyst is a distinct meningeal cyst that usually follows CSF signal, whereas this proteinaceous-appearing lesion is diagnosed as a neurenteric cyst.
Hemangioblastoma is typically an enhancing vascular tumor and is not a neurenteric cyst.
Schwannoma is an enhancing nerve-sheath tumor, not the specified congenital epithelial cyst.
Epidermoid cyst is distinct from neurenteric cyst and usually demonstrates diffusion restriction, which is absent here.
Neuroenteric cyst is a recognized spelling variant/synonym of neurenteric cyst.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Spelling variant of the full reference diagnosis

candidate_relations.reason: Chordoma is generally an enhancing destructive midline skull-base tumor, not a neurenteric cyst.
Hemangioma is a vascular lesion and does not match the nonenhancing neurenteric cyst.
Neurofibroma is a peripheral nerve-sheath tumor, not a neurenteric cyst.
